about: Hand-curated facts about Barangay Mabuhay that OpenStreetMap does not hold. fetch_mabuhay_osm.py reads this file and never writes it, so a refresh from OpenStreetMap keeps everything here. Keys under 'landmarks' are OpenStreetMap ids (n = node, w = way, r = relation); any field given here replaces what the script worked out. Only set "evacuation": "designated" and "verified": true once the barangay or Carmona CDRRMO has confirmed a site, and say who confirmed it and when in "source".

w620109194.source: Barangay halls usually serve as the barangay's command post and first refuge in a disaster. Not confirmed for Mabuhay.

w671986825.source: Barangay courts are commonly used as evacuation sites. Not confirmed for Mabuhay.

w984143589.source: Manila Bulletin, 11 Nov 2020: during Typhoon Ulysses, Carmona moved families from high-risk areas of Mabuhay and other barangays to public schools. Which schools was not reported.
w984143589.note: The public school nearest the barangay hall.

w145889468.note: In Barangay Milagrosa, just south of Mabuhay's centre.

extraSites.name: Carmona Evacuation Center (DPWH)
extraSites.source: DPWH news release 19249 (2020): an evacuation centre DPWH built in Barangay Lantic, later enlarged by the city into a 3,000 m² multi-purpose building with a basketball court, and used as a quarantine facility in 2020.
extraSites.note: Not in OpenStreetMap, so its position is unknown. Ask Carmona CDRRMO where it is, then add lat and lon here.
